messages.content:
You grade the output of one AI step in an English listening course for Taiwanese students (high school or university, around CEFR B1).
You get: the step, its input, the output after the app's own checks, and the criteria to grade by (in Traditional Chinese).
Grade only by the criteria. Score 1 to 5: 5 = fully meets them, a teacher would use it as is; 4 = small issues; 3 = usable but a teacher would fix something; 2 = a real error a learner could learn wrong; 1 = wrong or unusable.
Be strict about facts: a wrong meaning, a wrong grammar explanation, or a sound change that doesn't happen is at most 2.
Give reason: one or two short sentences in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) naming the most important issue, or what makes it good.

{"operation":"annotate","input":{"sentences":["I was so nervous before the interview, but it turned out to be a piece of cake."]},"output":{"notes":[{"v":2,"difficulty":"medium","highlights":[{"text":"so nervous","note":"常用的情緒描述，口語裡會弱讀 so"},{"text":"piece of cake","note":"常用片語，表示「非常容易」"}],"vocab":[{"term":"nervous","inSentence":"nervous","kind":"word","pos":"adj.","zh":"緊張、不安","ipa":"/ˈnɜːrvəs/","collocations":["feel nervous","get nervous","nervous about"],"examples":[{"en":"She gets nervous before exams.","zh":"她考試前會緊張。"}]},{"term":"turn out to be","inSentence":"turned out to be","kind":"phrase","pos":"phr.","zh":"結果證明是","ipa":"/tɜrn aʊt tu bi/","collocations":["turn out to be true","turn out to be helpful"],"examples":[{"en":"The mystery turned out to be simple.","zh":"那個謎題結果很簡單。"}]},{"term":"piece of cake","inSentence":"piece of cake","kind":"idiom","pos":"idiom","zh":"非常容易的事","ipa":"","collocations":["it's a piece of cake","make it a piece of cake"],"examples":[{"en":"The math problem was a piece of cake.","zh":"那道數學題很簡單。"}]}],"grammar":[{"point":"contrast with but","quote":"but it turned out to be a piece of cake","explanation":"用 but 連接兩個相反或出乎意料的事實；前半句說緊張，but 後半句給出結果。這是常見的轉折句型。","examples":[{"en":"I practiced a lot, but I still made mistakes.","zh":"我練習很多，但仍然犯錯。"}],"pitfall":"有些學生會在 but 前加逗號錯放或連接兩完整句忘記 but 的轉折意思；注意 but 直接表示對比，不等於 and。"}],"chunks":[],"connected":[{"text":"I was so","soundsLike":"I was so /aɪ wəz soʊ/","note":"so 常被弱讀，但在這裡為強調會發完整音；was 與 so 間連讀聽起來像一個小片段"},{"text":"turned out to be","soundsLike":"turn'd out tuh be /tɜrnd aʊt tə bi/","note":"turned out to be 常快速讀成 /tɜrnd aʊt tə/，to 類似弱讀 /tə/"}]}],"rawChars":[925]},"criteria":"單字的詞性、中文意思、音標正確；文法說明正確且適合 B1 學生；例句自然；中文解釋清楚、不冗長。有任何錯誤的講解最多 2 分。a piece of cake 的意思必須是「很簡單」。"}

message.content: {"score":5,"reason":"說明準確且適合 B1 學生：單字詞性、中文意思與例句自然；文法解釋正確且不冗長；特別強調了片語發音與弱讀。a piece of cake 正確標示為「非常容易」。"}
